login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back to Huddle.
login.magicHint: We'll email you a link to sign in without a password.
login.magicSent: If the address is registered, you'll shortly receive an email with your sign-in link.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: For presidents, secretaries and staff who want to run their club on Huddle. Athletes and families join by invitation.
register.terms: I accept the privacy policy and terms of service

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.

magic.failed: This link is invalid or has expired.

forgot.title: Recover password
forgot.subtitle: We'll email you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sent: If the address is registered, you'll shortly receive an email.

reset.title: New password
reset.done: Password updated. You can now sign in.

invitation.title: You're invited
invitation.existing: You already have an account with {email}: accept to add this club.
invitation.newAccount: Complete your details to create your account.
invitation.passwordHint: Optional: you can always sign in with an email link.
invitation.invalid: This invitation is invalid, expired or already used.

clubs.title: Your clubs
clubs.subtitle: Choose the club to work on.
clubs.empty: You're not part of any club yet.
clubs.createSubtitle: You can complete the legal details later.

home.title: Welcome, {name}
home.subtitle: Training, call-up and messaging tools are coming in the next releases.

club.title: Club profile
club.name: Name
club.federationsHint: Federations and sports bodies, comma separated (e.g. FIGC, CSI).
club.readOnly: Only administrators can edit these details.

seasons.title: Seasons
seasons.subtitle: Only one season can be open at a time.
seasons.name: Name
seasons.empty: No seasons yet. Create the first one to get started.

members.title: People
members.subtitle: Staff, athletes and families with access to the club.
members.inviteHint: They'll get an email with a sign-in link. The invitation expires after 7 days.

audit.title: Activity log
audit.subtitle: Sensitive operations performed in the club. The log cannot be edited.

security.title: Security
security.twoFactorRequired: Your role requires two-step verification. Turn it on to keep managing the club.
security.twoFactorIntro: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…).
security.scan: Scan the QR code with your app, or enter the key manually.
security.recoveryHint: Keep them somewhere safe: each one lets you sign in if you lose your phone. They won't be shown again.
security.disableHint: Enter a code from your app to turn off verification.
security.currentPasswordHint: Leave empty if you never set a password.

privacy.title: Privacy and personal data
privacy.imageReleaseHint: Allows publishing photos and videos you appear in.
privacy.exportHint: Get a copy of the personal data Huddle keeps about you (GDPR, art. 15).
